name: megascenes-colorize-photos
description: Bring black and white photos from your MegaScenes library to color: family photos, old portraits, weddings and places, with the same composition and the same people.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a black and white photo from your MegaScenes library, a scan or a photo of the print, and add any colors you know: her dress was light blue, the car was red, the leaves were autumn gold. You get the same photo in natural color, with the same composition, people, faces and background.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the colorized photo needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The photo opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For family albums, old portraits of your grandparents, wedding photos from decades ago and pictures of the places you come from.

Limitations: the colors are a plausible interpretation, not the real ones of the day. Only your own or your family's photos that you have the right to edit, never a famous person. One photo per run, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Add natural color to black and white photos
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Colorize the old black and white photo of my grandparents in my MegaScenes library
Add color to our family wedding photo from 1962; her dress was light blue
Bring my latest black and white upload to color

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Colorize the black and white photo of my grandparents in my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one colorized photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can colorize a photo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The colorizing models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Colorize the black and white wedding photo of my grandparents in my MegaScenes library; her dress was light blue. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my colorized photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my colorized photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
